sources.label: ARY Live — community patches for ARY PLUS, for use with Morphe
sources.author: ARY Live
patch_list: Skips PairIP / Play license dialog so resigned sideload builds can open.
Adds options to change the app icon and app name. Select Original for the real ARY PLUS logo, or Custom for the Morphe-style blue plus.
Disables interstitials, banners, native ads, Revive ads, home feed ad injectors, and IMA video ads. Shows Video ads skipped when drama/player ads are blocked.
